notes.title: V1.0.6 Minor bug fix
notes.content: * If the game was saved after placing a bet and prior to starting the race, the betting ticket would fail to display upon reloading the game.

notes.title: V1.0.5c minor fix and improvements
notes.content:
* If a leading zero was entered in the betting box, it would no longer register any other numbers until the "clear" button was pressed.
* Improved the game's memory usage.

notes.title: V1.0.5b Update and fixes.
notes.content:
* The player is now given the option to enter a betting limit of $1000, $3000 or $5000 at the start of a new game.
* Fixed a visual anomaly which affected the start button when pressed on the very first race of a game.
* Fixed a bug which allowed the purchase of a horse if the "insufficient funds" button was clicked.
* Added volume controls.
* Unfortunately, due to software idiosyncrasies, this version is not compatible with previous 1.0.4 saves.

notes.title: Problems with the latest 1.0.5 update
notes.content:
It appears that the latest V1.0.5 update has introduced a bug which causes crashes.
Even though I do my best to avoid these situations, things can, and do go wrong at times.
The game has been reverted back to the previous V1.0.4 build until I can resolve the problem.
My apologies for the inconvenience caused and thanks to those of you who have contacted me.
Regards,
FNS

notes.title: Small update 1.0.5
notes.content: * The player is now given the option to enter a betting cap limit of between $1000 and $5000 inclusive, at the start of a new game.

notes.title: Update V1.0.4
notes.content: * Jockeys riding in first-time starter's races no longer commence with zero career statistics when a new game is commenced or reset.

notes.title: update v1.0.3
notes.content: Game automatically adapts to full screen on higher resolution monitors. 100% Scaling still needs to be set manually through Windows display settings.

notes.title: Update v1.0.3
notes.content: Game now adapts to full screen on higher resolution monitors. 100% Scaling still needs to be set manually through Windows display settings.

notes.title: Update V1.0.2
notes.content:
* Fixed the "Cup Day is here.. race 5" notice which incorrectly displayed prior to entering the number of days at the start of a new game.
* The race caller has now made the effort to wear formal attire to the DATR Cup event.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
* Please note that this version is not compatible with previous V1.0.0 saves.
* Removed the 10,20,30 day game length pre-sets. Players can now choose between 10 to 999 days leading up to the DATR cup.
* A purchased horse can now be renamed.
* Fixed a bug which allowed a drugged horse to permanently retain a small percentage of the performance boost after the race.
* Improved the graphic fidelity in some of the billboard track assets.
* Removed a redundant feature which did not allow players to reset the game until the 3rd day.
